posts.raw_content: Finishing up our Costco run on Grant St. in Tucson Wednesday, and while getting ready to leave I noticed an elderly couple at a cafe table.  The man, looked like he had been rode hard and put away wet, probably been through some shit in his life including a few foreign wars...He had on an old plain white tee, and blue jeans, and an old and well worn MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN baseball cap on his head.  I moved closer to him and got his attention, and said, "We LOVE your hat! Wear it proudly!" He seemed a little taken aback, and though I didn't notice, my wife said other people were sneering at us and him while we interacted.  Right before I started to turn and walk away it was obvious that he was choking up that I said that to him.  My wife said she thought he was about to cry.  I hope he has a wonderful remainder of his life, and I hope we can fix this shit for people like him who have suffered through life way more than my whiny ass has.
